title: astracantha spectabilis
intro: Astracantha spectabilis, commonly known as Orobanchaceous or root parasitic plant. It is a species of flowering plant in the broomrape family, Pedicularis, that obtains its nutrients by parasitizing the roots of other plants. Astracantha spectabilis has been reported to possess several health benefits, including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions in reducing blood sugar levels and improving cardiovascular health. The bioactive constituents of Astracantha spectabilis include alkaloids, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
